QuestInfo.name: [NLC] In the Footsteps of the Krakians
QuestInfo.0: Corine wants to carry on with the investigation from the Temporary Base Camp in the jungle. Talk with her to see what comes next.
QuestInfo.1: Corine asks you to look for traces of the ancient Krakians while fighting Gryphon monsters, which the Krakians once hunted.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated many Gryphon monsters and sought for ways to enter the Krakian city, but couldn't find any paths that led there.

mob.0: It's a ridiculous story, but it offers a great opportunity for study. You may be able to find traces of the Krakians if you hunt the Gryphons!
